extracted.subtask_description: Menu and consumer-facing service, dietary, and availability guidelines for a fast-casual restaurant (The Stand). Includes item descriptions, allergy/disclaimer language, customization/pricing rules, and location-specific availability notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allergy warning for specific ingredients
rubrics_metrics.description: Allergy warning: red curry sauce contains shellfish
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit per-item allergy callouts for ingredients that contain common allergens.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shared-preparation cross-contact disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: PLEASE NOTE: Vegan, vegetarian and non-vegetarian items at The Stand are prepared on the same cooking surfaces. Although efforts are made to avoid cross-contact of allergens, The Stand does not guarantee that cross-contact with allergens will not occur.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customers are instructed: Before placing your order, please inform a team member if you or anyone in your party has a food allergy. Similar cross-contact warnings repeat for vegan/vegetarian and gluten/dairy categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food-safety consumption advisory
rubrics_metrics.description: Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of food-borne illness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General safety advisory presented with nutrition/allergy information to inform customers of risks associated with undercooked items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nutrition information disclaimer and calorie guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: 2,000 calories a day is used for general nutrition advice, but calorie needs vary. Additional nutrition information available upon request. We’re committed to providing accurate nutritional information, but because our recipes are prepared to order, there may be differences between the actual nutritional content of your order and the nutritional values provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains that menu nutrition values are derived from standardized recipes, may vary with modifications, and additional info can be requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customization and pricing rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Add Any Sauce or Condiment: Free. Extra Patty — Add an Extra Patty for an additional charge. Add Loaded Toppings: Additional Costs Apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies which customizations are complimentary (sauces/condiments) and which incur extra charges (extra patties, loaded toppings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bun and base options and choice availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Bun Options: Gourmet Brioche Bun, Wheat Bun, Lettuce Wrap, Gluten-Free Bun, Pretzel Bun. All our bread is locally made with only the finest ingredients and delivered fresh daily.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists specific bun options customers can choose and claims about local sourcing/delivery frequency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topping and condiment limits for certain items
rubrics_metrics.description: Stand Hot Dog — Choose from our list of condiments (limit 4 toppings) or add loaded toppings for an additional charge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enforces a limit on included toppings (4) for hot dogs, with loaded toppings as paid extras.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location-specific availability of menu items
rubrics_metrics.description: *Only available at California locations. Also: Elote Dog — Only available in The Woodlands, TX.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some items are restricted to certain stores/regions; the menu marks these with explicit notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kids' menu composition and side/drink options
rubrics_metrics.description: All Kid's menu items served with choice of Stand Fries, Apple Slices, Stand Chips, Stand Slaw, Stand Rice, Sweet Potato Fries (additional) or Mac n' Cheese (additional). Add a Kids' drink (additional).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines included and optional sides for kids' meals and indicates additional charges for some side/drink upgrades.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dietary-friendly category groupings
rubrics_metrics.description: Vegetarian Friendly Alternatives; Gluten-Free Friendly Alternatives; Vegan Friendly Alternatives; Dairy-Free Friendly Alternatives — each section lists items and modifications considered friendly to that diet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Menu organizes items by dietary accommodation and lists examples of items that fit each category (e.g., Kale Quinoa Crunch Salad under vegetarian and gluten-free lists).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific modification instructions for vegan requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Veggie Bliss (MODIFIED TO VEGAN) — veggie patty (quinoa, brown rice, carrots, pea protein, corn, black beans, scallions, and spices) guacamole, pickled red onion, on a un-buttered wheat bun. (Be sure to specify no pepper jack cheese, crispy onion strings, sweet chili aioli, and no butter on bun)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives explicit step-by-step removals customers must request to make particular items vegan; indicates the restaurant will modify when instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gluten-free option specifics and restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Gluten Free BYO Protein Options — burger patty (with no seasoning), chicken, veggie patty. Gluten Free BYO Bun Options — gluten-free bun, lettuce wrap. Gluten Free Salad Dressings — house vinaigrette, ranch dressing, honey lime vinaigrette, charred corn vinaigrette.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies which proteins, bun choices, and dressings are considered gluten-free options and notes that some preparations (e.g., seasoning) could affect suitability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dairy-free friendly modifications and component notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Dairy-Free Friendly items and modifications (e.g., Kale Quinoa Crunch Salad (Modified) — be sure to specify no parmesan; Seared Ahi Tuna Salad (Modified) — be sure to specify no crispy onion strings). Dairy-Free Friendly Bun Options and Condiments lists also provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides per-item modification instructions to make items dairy-free and lists buns/condiments/loaded toppings considered dairy-free; notes some sauces contain egg.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ingredient/format labeling for served temperature or style
rubrics_metrics.description: Seared Ahi Tuna (served chilled); Handmade Shakes made with vanilla ice cream or local vanilla soft-serve (varies by location).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes preparation/serving temperature (chilled) and ingredient sourcing variability by location to inform customer expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sourcing and product-variation claims
rubrics_metrics.description: All our bread is locally made with only the finest ingredients and delivered fresh daily. Our beer menus always feature our Stand Blonde Ale, Stand Hef and Stand IPA. Handmade Shakes made with local vanilla soft-serve (varies by location).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicates local sourcing, house-brand beverage features, and product variation by location as part of menu positioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modification effects on nutrition and accuracy disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: We will do our best to accommodate special requests to prepare your meal just the way you like it. Modifications may alter the nutritional values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warns customers that customizations can change nutrition values and that provided nutrition info is approximate.
